name: Direct Debit Management Process
description: The end-to-end operational procedure for managing direct debits at FirstUK Bank, overseen by the Head of Operations and applicable to Operations, Payments, and Branch staff.
context: FirstUK Bank — Direct Debit Management SOP

name: Head of Operations
description: The owner of the Direct Debit Management SOP responsible for its oversight and maintenance.

name: Operations Staff
description: Staff members within the Operations and Payments departments who are the primary audience and executors of the Direct Debit Management SOP.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Branch Staff
description: Front-office personnel who are part of the target audience for the Direct Debit Management procedures.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Customer Service
description: Support personnel who are the intended audience for the Direct Debit Management SOP.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Branch Staff, Customer Service

name: Direct Debit Management Process
description: An end-to-end operational procedure for the lifecycle management of Direct Debits. This includes mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation, ensuring adherence to Direct Debit Scheme rules and customer protection standards.
context: Establish procedures for managing Direct Debits, including mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation
ensuring compliance with Direct Debit Scheme rules and customer protection

name: Direct Debit Lifecycle Management Process
aliases: Direct Debit mandate collection and setup
description: An end-to-end operational workflow covering the entire lifecycle of Direct Debits, from initial mandate collection and setup through to processing, failure handling, dispute resolution, and final cancellation.
context: Direct Debit mandate collection and setup

name: Standing Order Management Process
description: The operational workflow for managing fixed-amount payments initiated by the customer. The process is characterized by customer-led control and immediate cancellation capabilities.
context: Control: You tell bank what to pay

name: Direct Debit Management Process
description: The operational workflow for managing variable payments initiated by a biller or company. This process provides protection under the Direct Debit Guarantee and typically requires a 5-day notice for cancellation.

name: Customer
description: The bank client who initiates standing orders and maintains control over what the bank pays for that specific product.
context: You tell bank what to pay

name: Biller/Company
description: The external entity that initiates a Direct Debit and sends payment instructions to the bank.

name: Standing Order Cancellation
description: The action of terminating a standing order, which can be performed at any time with immediate effect.

name: Direct Debit Cancellation
description: The action of terminating a Direct Debit mandate. While it can be done anytime, a 5-day notice period is typically required.

name: Direct Debit Guarantee Verification
description: The mandatory protection layer applicable to Direct Debit processes, ensuring full compliance with the Direct Debit Guarantee.

name: Direct Debit Setup and Payment Process
description: An end-to-end operational workflow covering the initiation of a Direct Debit by a biller, the customer authorization, system setup, and the subsequent automated payment processing and dispute handling.

name: Biller Authorization Request
description: The initial stage of the process where the biller requests authorization to set up a direct debit from the customer.

name: Biller
description: The external entity that initiates the authorization request and submits payment instructions to the bank.

name: Customer Mandate Signing
description: The stage where the customer provides formal consent by signing the Direct Debit mandate.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who authorizes the direct debit mandate and has the right to dispute or cancel the arrangement.

name: System Mandate Setup
description: The operational step where the signed direct debit mandate is recorded and configured within the bank's systems.

name: Bank System
description: The automated banking infrastructure responsible for recording mandates and processing auto-debit payments.

name: Payment Instruction Submission
description: The step where the biller submits a formal instruction to trigger a payment from the customer's account.

name: Auto-Debit Payment Processing
description: The automated execution of the payment from the customer's account based on the existing mandate and biller instruction.

name: Customer Dispute or Cancellation Trigger
description: A point in the process where the customer may exercise their right to dispute a payment or cancel the mandate entirely.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Setup Process
description: The operational procedure for initiating and collecting a Direct Debit mandate when a customer agrees to allow a biller to take payments from their account. It involves the collection of account details, biller information, and customer authorization.
context: Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: DD Mandate Initiation
description: The initial stage of the Direct Debit setup where the customer is asked by a biller for payment authorization and signs a mandate form containing account and biller details.
context: Biller asks: "Can we take payment by Direct Debit?"
Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who signs up for a service and provides authorization for a biller to collect payments via Direct Debit.
context: Customer signs up for utility bill, gym membership, insurance, etc.
Customer agrees and signs mandate form

name: Biller
description: The entity (e.g., utility company, gym, insurance provider) that requests the Direct Debit mandate and provides their DDIC number.
context: Biller asks: "Can we take payment by Direct Debit?"

name: Bank Account
description: The customer's account from which payments will be drawn, identified by the account number and sort code on the mandate form.
context: Bank account details (account number, sort code)

name: Direct Debit Mandate Form
description: The authorization document containing bank account details, biller details, amount type (fixed or variable), and the customer's signature.
context: Customer agrees and signs mandate form
Mandate Form Contains: Bank account details (account number, sort code), Biller details (name, DDIC number), Amount type (fixed or variable), Customer authorization (signature)

name: Direct Debit Mandate Setup Process
description: The operational workflow for processing a Direct Debit mandate after it has been received by FirstUK from a biller or customer. The process involves verification, recording, and notification steps.
context: FirstUK doesn't issue the mandate; customer signs it and biller sends it to us

name: Mandate Receipt
description: The initial stage where the mandate is received by the bank, originating from either the biller or the customer.
context: Mandate received from biller or customer

name: Account Details Verification
description: A verification step to ensure that the provided account details are in a valid format and that the account actually exists.

name: Customer Identity Confirmation
description: The process of confirming the identity of the customer associated with the mandate.

name: Mandate System Recording
description: The administrative action of recording the validated mandate into the bank's internal systems.

name: Biller Setup Notification
description: The bank notifies the biller that the mandate setup is complete via an ARUDD message.

name: Customer Confirmation Notification
description: The final step where the customer is informed that the mandate has been successfully set up.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking entity responsible for verifying account details, confirming identity, recording mandates, and sending notifications.

name: Biller
description: The external party that receives the signed mandate from the customer and transmits it to FirstUK Bank.

name: Customer
description: The account holder who signs the mandate and receives the final confirmation of setup.

name: Mandate Applicant
description: The customer whose identity is confirmed and whose account is used for the Direct Debit setup.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The authorization document signed by the customer and sent to the bank to enable direct debit payments.
context: Mandate received from biller or customer
FirstUK doesn't issue the mandate; customer signs it

name: Direct Debit Mandate Setup Process
description: The operational workflow for establishing a Direct Debit mandate within the bank's systems, including the recording of specific mandate and biller details.

name: System Entry for Mandate Setup
description: The discrete action of recording mandate details into the banking system, capturing the Mandate Reference, Customer Account, Biller details, and status.

name: Customer Account
description: The specific customer account associated with the Direct Debit mandate being set up in the system.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The financial authorization being established, identified by a unique Mandate Reference and containing biller details, amount types, and start dates.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Validation Process
description: The operational workflow for validating Direct Debit mandates to ensure account activity, holder matching, biller legitimacy, and authorization before processing.
context: If Validation Fails: Return mandate to sender

name: Account Status and Holder Verification
description: The initial verification stage where the system or actor confirms the account exists, is active, and the account holder matches the mandate details.

name: Biller DDIC Validation
description: A specific check to ensure the Biller Direct Debit Identifier Code (DDIC) is valid and represents a registered biller.

name: Mandate Authorization Review
description: The review of the mandate form to ensure it has been properly signed and authorized by the account holder.

name: Duplicate Mandate Check
description: A verification step to ensure that no duplicate mandates for the same biller already exist for the account.
context: No duplicate mandates for same biller

name: Mandate Validation Decision Gate
description: A branching point where the mandate is either processed (if all checks pass) or returned to the sender for correction (if any check fails).

name: Mandate Rejection and Request for Correction
description: The action taken when validation fails, involving returning the mandate to the sender and requesting a corrected version.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Compliance Gate
description: The mandatory control point ensuring the mandate meets all operational and regulatory requirements before it is allowed to be processed.

name: Biller Submission Process
description: The operational workflow for processing payment instructions submitted by billers via the Direct Debit scheme, encompassing validation, debiting, and notification.

name: Payment Amount Determination
description: The initial stage where the biller calculates the specific amount due from the customer, such as a monthly utility charge.
context: Biller determines amount due (e.g., £75 for monthly electricity)

name: Payment Instruction Submission
description: The action of the biller sending the payment instruction to the bank through the established Direct Debit scheme.
context: Submits instruction via Direct Debit scheme

name: Payment Instruction Receipt
description: The point at which FirstUK Bank receives the payment instruction submitted by the biller.

name: Mandate Validation
description: The verification process where FirstUK checks the instruction against the existing mandate to ensure the account is active and the amount is within agreed limits.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Account Debit Execution
description: The financial action of debiting the validated payment amount from the customer's account.

name: Biller Success/Failure Notification
description: The final step where the biller is informed whether the payment instruction was successfully processed or failed.

name: Biller
description: The external entity that determines the amount due, submits payment instructions, and receives notifications regarding the outcome of the debit.
context: Submits instruction via Direct Debit scheme

name: FirstUK
description: The bank responsible for receiving payment instructions, validating them against mandates, and executing the account debit.

name: Mandate Compliance Gate
description: A decision point where the payment is checked against the mandate limits and account status; success leads to debiting, failure leads to a failure notification.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Direct Debit Mandate Verification
description: A mandatory check to ensure the payment instruction adheres to the terms of the Direct Debit mandate before funds are moved.
context: FirstUK validates against mandate (amount within limits, account active)

name: Customer Account
description: The account from which funds are debited following successful mandate validation.

name: Direct Debit Processing Rules
description: The operational workflow for validating and executing direct debit transactions. It ensures mandates are active and funds are available before a debit is processed.

name: Pre-Debit Validation Step
description: A discrete stage where the system or staff verifies the mandate status, amount limits, fund availability, and the timing of the instruction before allowing a debit.

name: Debit Validation Gate
description: A branching point based on the outcome of the pre-debit validation checks. If all checks pass, the debit proceeds; if any fail, the debit is rejected and notifications are sent.

name: Debit Rejection and Notification Step
description: The action taken when a validation check fails, involving the rejection of the debit and the notification of the biller with the reason for failure.
context: Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: Biller
description: The external entity requesting the direct debit payment who must be notified if a transaction is rejected.

name: Customer
description: The account holder whose funds are being validated for the direct debit and who may incur charges upon rejection.
context: Customer may be charged (varies by biller)

name: Debit Account
description: The customer account being checked for sufficient funds to cover the direct debit instruction.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The authorization record checked to ensure it is active and not canceled before a debit is permitted.

name: Direct Debit Transaction
description: The specific financial event being validated, which may be either processed or rejected based on the validation rules.

name: Biller Payment Processing
description: An operational workflow for processing biller payments via BACS. The process involves a submission window 3 days prior to payment, overnight processing, and settlement on the next business day.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

name: Biller Payment Submission
description: The initial stage of the payment process where billers submit payment requests. This must occur 3 days before the scheduled payment date.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date

name: Overnight BACS Processing
description: The technical execution phase where FirstUK processes the submitted payments overnight using the BACS system.

name: Payment Settlement
description: The final stage of the workflow where funds are delivered to the biller. This occurs on the business day following the overnight processing.
context: Funds reach biller next business day

name: Biller
description: The entity responsible for submitting payment requests within the defined three-day window and the recipient of the settled funds.
context: Billers submit 3 days before payment date
Funds reach biller next business day

name: FirstUK
description: The banking institution responsible for the overnight BACS processing of payments.

name: Failed Direct Debit Handling Process
description: The operational procedure for managing and categorising direct debit failures. This process identifies specific failure scenarios such as closed accounts, insufficient funds, or cancelled mandates.

name: Direct Debit Failure Scenario Identification
description: The step of identifying the specific reason why a direct debit has failed. Common scenarios include closed accounts, insufficient funds, frozen accounts, or cancelled mandates.

name: Closed Account
description: An account that has been closed, resulting in the failure of an attempted direct debit transaction.

name: Frozen Account
description: An account that is currently frozen, preventing the processing of direct debit payments.

name: Canceled Direct Debit Mandate
description: A direct debit mandate that has been canceled by the customer, specifically in cases where the customer failed to inform the biller of the cancellation.

name: Failed Direct Debit Transaction
description: A financial transaction involving a direct debit that failed to complete due to account status or mandate issues.

name: Direct Debit Failure Process
description: An operational workflow triggered when a direct debit payment attempt fails. It manages the system blocking of payment, notification to both the biller and customer, and the subsequent resolution or retry options.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Debit Attempt Failure and Recording
description: The initial stage where the system blocks a payment due to reasons such as insufficient funds or a closed account and records the failure with a specific reason.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Biller Notification
description: The process of sending an automated ARUDD rejection message to the biller, which includes the specific reason code for the payment failure.

name: Customer Notification
description: An optional notification sent to the customer via Email or SMS if they have opted in, detailing the amount, the biller, and the reason for failure.

name: Customer Remediation Action
description: The stage where the customer is required to resolve the failure by providing funds, contacting the biller for alternative payment, or cancelling the Direct Debit.
context: Customer must: Provide sufficient funds, OR Contact biller to arrange alternative payment, OR Cancel Direct Debit

name: Payment Retry
description: A stage where the biller may choose to retry the payment, typically within a 3–5 day window, provided funds have become available.
context: Retry typically succeeds if funds now available

name: Automated Payment System
description: The system responsible for blocking failed payments, recording the reason for failure, and sending automated ARUDD rejection messages.

name: Biller
description: The external party requesting payment who receives the failure notification and decides whether to retry the debit attempt.
context: Contact biller to arrange alternative payment

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who is notified of the payment failure and must take corrective action to resolve the outstanding payment.

name: Retry Decision Gate
description: A decision point where the biller determines whether to initiate a payment retry within the 3-5 day window following a failure.

name: Failed Direct Debit Mandate
description: A direct debit instruction that has failed to execute due to insufficient funds or account closure.
context: System blocks payment (insufficient funds, closed account, etc.)

name: Direct Debit Disputes and Claims Process
description: The operational workflow for handling customer claims regarding unauthorized direct debits under the Direct Debit Guarantee. It ensures full refunds are processed within a 10 business day timeline regardless of the specific error scenario.
context: FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: Customer Claim Filing
description: The initial action where a customer notifies FirstUK that a direct debit was unauthorized or incorrect.
context: Customer contacts bank: "I didn't authorize this!"

name: Direct Debit Refund Processing
description: The execution of a full refund to the customer within 10 business days following an unauthorized debit claim.
context: FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking entity responsible for receiving claims and issuing refunds under the Direct Debit Guarantee.
context: FirstUK refunds full amount within 10 business days

name: Customer
description: The account holder who identifies an unauthorized debit and initiates a claim for a refund.
context: Customer contacts bank: "I didn't authorize this!"

name: Biller
description: The third-party entity that initiates the direct debit charge, which may be fraudulent, incorrect in amount, or processed after cancellation.

name: Claiming Customer
description: The specific customer subject to the Direct Debit Guarantee who is seeking a refund for an unauthorized transaction.

name: Unauthorized Direct Debit Transaction
description: A financial event where funds are deducted from an account without proper authorization or in violation of the agreed amount/status.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The payment authorization being disputed or cancelled as part of the claims process.
context: Full protection under Direct Debit Guarantee

name: Claim Process
description: An operational workflow for handling customer claims, involving reportage via phone, email, or branch, followed by investigation, decisioning, and potential refund.

name: Customer Issue Reporting
description: The initial stage where the customer reports an issue through specified channels: phone (0800-555-2265), email (support@firstuk.bank), or in-person branch visits.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who initiates the claim process by reporting an issue.

name: Claim Investigation
description: The internal review stage where FirstUK verifies Direct Debit details, confirms mandate status (active/canceled), contacts billers, and assesses claim validity.

name: FirstUK Bank Staff
description: The bank personnel responsible for investigating claim details, contacting billers, and determining the outcome of the claim.

name: Claim Approval Decision
description: A branching point where the claim is either Approved, leading to a refund within 10 days, or Denied, requiring an explanation to the customer.

name: Refund Execution
description: The final stage for approved claims where funds are credited to the customer's account and a confirmation is sent.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The Direct Debit arrangement being investigated during the claim process to confirm if the mandate is active or canceled.

name: Customer Account
description: The account to which refund funds are credited upon a successful claim decision.

name: Dispute Resolution Process
description: The operational workflow triggered when a customer disagrees with a bank outcome or is unhappy with a decision made by FirstUK. It outlines the path from internal escalation to external regulatory resolution.
context: Dispute Resolution (if Customer Disagrees with Bank Outcome)
If customer unhappy with FirstUK's decision

name: Managerial Escalation Step
description: The initial internal action taken when a customer is unhappy with a decision, involving the movement of the dispute to a manager for review.

name: Formal Complaint Process Initiation
description: The formal procedure for handling customer grievances, governed by the specific complaints policy.

name: External Ombudsman Referral
description: The final stage of the dispute process where the matter is referred to the Financial Ombudsman Service if the issue remains unresolved internally.

name: Manager
description: The internal bank employee responsible for reviewing escalated decisions when a customer expresses dissatisfaction.

name: Financial Ombudsman Service
description: The external regulatory body that handles unresolved disputes between the customer and FirstUK Bank.

name: Customer
description: The bank client who is unhappy with a decision and initiates the dispute resolution process.
context: if Customer Disagrees with Bank Outcome
If customer unhappy with FirstUK's decision

name: Internal Resolution Outcome Gate
description: A decision point based on whether the dispute is resolved internally; if it remains unresolved, it triggers the referral to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

name: Level 1 — Managerial Review
description: The first tier of escalation where a decision is moved from a staff member to a manager.

name: Level 2 — External Ombudsman Review
description: The highest tier of escalation involving an external regulatory body after internal processes are exhausted.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Cancellation Process
description: The operational workflow for cancelling a Direct Debit mandate, providing multiple channels for the customer to initiate the request via the bank or the biller.

name: Bank-Initiated Mandate Cancellation
description: The process step where the customer contacts FirstUK Bank through phone, email, branch visit, or online form to request the cancellation of a mandate.

name: Biller-Initiated Mandate Cancellation
description: The process step where the customer contacts the biller to cease collection, which may result in an automatic notification to FirstUK Bank.

name: FirstUK Bank Staff
description: The bank personnel or systems responsible for receiving and processing mandate cancellation requests via phone, email, branch, or online channels.

name: Biller
description: The third-party entity receiving payments who can cease collections and potentially notify the bank automatically of a mandate cancellation.

name: Customer
description: The account holder who initiates the mandate cancellation process by contacting either the bank or the biller.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The specific payment authorization being cancelled through the described operational steps.

name: FirstUK Cancellation Process
description: An operational workflow for processing the cancellation of a mandate. The process takes effect immediately without a notice period and blocks future payments, including pending payments if cancelled before the settlement date.
context: Effective Date: Immediate (no notice period required)
Any Pending Payments: Blocked if cancellation before settlement date

name: Verify Customer Identity
description: The initial action in the cancellation process to ensure the identity of the customer requesting the cancellation is authenticated.

name: Confirm Mandate Details
description: A step to validate and confirm the specific details of the mandate that is being requested for cancellation.

name: Set Mandate Status to Canceled
description: The administrative action of updating the mandate's status within the system to 'Canceled'.

name: Notify Biller via Automated ARUDD
description: An automated step where the biller is notified of the cancellation through the Automated Request for Direct Debit (ARUDD) mechanism.

name: Send Confirmation to Customer
description: The final communication step to inform the customer that their cancellation request has been processed.

name: Block Future Payments
description: An action to ensure that no further payments are processed against the cancelled mandate.

name: Customer
description: The individual requesting the cancellation of their mandate and the recipient of the confirmation notification.

name: Automated ARUDD System
description: The automated system responsible for sending the cancellation notification to the biller.

name: Biller
description: The external entity (merchant/service provider) notified when a mandate is cancelled.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The specific financial mandate being verified and moved to a 'Canceled' status during this procedure.

name: Biller Cancellation Process
description: An operational workflow triggered when a Biller requests the cancellation of a mandate, resulting in the update of the mandate status and the cessation of further debits.

name: Biller Cancellation Instruction Submission
description: The initial action where the Biller submits a formal instruction to cancel the mandate.

name: Cancellation Request Processing
description: The internal action where FirstUK receives the cancellation instruction and processes it within their systems.

name: Mandate Status Update
description: The stage where the status of the direct debit mandate is updated to reflect the cancellation.

name: Cessation of Debits
description: The final outcome of the process ensuring that no further financial debits are processed against the cancelled mandate.

name: Biller
description: The external party responsible for initiating the cancellation by submitting an instruction.

name: FirstUK
description: The banking entity responsible for receiving and processing the cancellation request and updating the mandate status.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The specific authorization agreement being cancelled during the Biller Cancellation Process.

name: Account Management Process
description: Operational workflow governing the management of Direct Debit mandates during specific account changes, including address updates, account migration, and fraud-related freezes.

name: Address Change Notification
description: Automatic notification sent to the biller when a customer updates their address, ensuring the mandate remains active without payment interruption.
context: If Customer Changes Address: Biller notified automatically

name: Old Mandate Cancellation
description: The cancellation of an existing direct debit mandate triggered by the closure of the associated bank account.
context: If Customer Gets New Account: Old mandate canceled (if account closed)

name: New Mandate Authorization
description: The requirement for a customer to provide authorization for a new direct debit mandate when transitioning to a new account.
context: Customer must authorize new mandate for new account

name: Biller Account Detail Update
description: The step ensuring the biller is provided with the updated account details necessary to process payments for a new account.
context: Biller must have new account details

name: Direct Debit Temporary Block
description: The temporary suspension of all Direct Debit payments when an account is placed on a Fraud Hold.
context: If Account Frozen (Fraud Hold): Direct Debits blocked temporarily

name: Fraud Hold Biller Notification
description: The communication of a payment failure to the biller via a generic message when an account is frozen due to fraud.

name: Customer Fraud Resolution
description: The mandatory resolution process the customer must undergo to lift a fraud hold before payment services can resume.
context: Customer resolution required before payment resumes

name: Customer
description: The account holder responsible for initiating address changes, authorizing new mandates, and resolving fraud holds.

name: Biller
description: The external entity receiving automatic notifications and providing the account details required for mandate processing.
context: Biller must have new account details

name: Account Change Trigger
description: A branching point based on the type of account change (Address Change vs. New Account vs. Frozen Account) which determines the mandate handling logic.

name: Account Holder
description: The subject of the account management steps whose address, account status, or mandate authorization is being processed.

name: Frozen Account
description: An account subjected to a fraud hold, resulting in the temporary blocking of Direct Debits.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The payment authorization that may remain active, be cancelled, or require new authorization based on account changes.

name: Weekly Quality Assurance Review
description: A weekly operational procedure designed to ensure the accuracy of Direct Debit processing and the resolution of failures and disputes.

name: Operations Staff
description: Staff members responsible for conducting the weekly checks on Direct Debit processing values, failed collections, and customer/biller complaints.

name: Direct Debit Processing Metrics Check
description: A check performed by Operations Staff to monitor the total value of Direct Debits processed, the number of failed collections, and the volume of customer disputes and biller complaints.
context: Total value of Direct Debits processed

name: Direct Debit Reconciliation
description: A verification process to ensure DD transactions align with biller instructions and that no duplicate payments have occurred.

name: Failed Direct Debit Investigation
description: The process of investigating Direct Debits that failed to collect during the weekly review period.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The financial arrangement and transaction mechanism being reviewed for processing errors, failures, and disputes.
context: Total value of Direct Debits processed

name: Direct Debit Audit Trail and Record Retention Process
description: The operational procedure for maintaining system records of direct debit mandates, payments, and disputes, ensuring compliance with regulatory retention periods.

name: System Records Engine
description: The automated system responsible for capturing and storing mandates, payment instructions, debit outcomes, and customer communications.

name: POCA Regulatory Retention Check
description: A mandatory regulatory gate requiring that all direct debit related records be retained for a minimum of 6 years as per POCA regulations.

name: Mandate Record Maintenance
description: The action of recording and maintaining all active and canceled direct debit mandates within the system.

name: Payment Instruction Logging
description: The action of logging all payment instructions received by the bank.

name: Debit Outcome Recording
description: The recording of both successful and failed debit attempts for audit purposes.

name: Dispute and Outcome Documentation
description: The process of documenting all customer disputes and the final outcomes associated with those disputes.

name: Customer Communication Archiving
description: The action of capturing and storing all communications exchanged with the customer.

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: The authorization records, including both active and canceled statuses, subject to the 6-year retention rule.

name: Head of Operations
description: The senior operational authority responsible for the formal approval and sign-off of the procedure document.

name: Head of Compliance
description: The senior compliance authority responsible for ensuring the procedure meets regulatory requirements and providing formal sign-off.
